audit.whatIsWrong: Fling was called Singed's W in six places ('W-fling', 'W fling', 'he can W you under tower'), and Mega Adhesive's grounding never appeared at all.
audit.why: Riot's kit: E Fling, 125 range, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, knocks the target behind him and roots them if they land in Mega Adhesive. W Mega Adhesive is the 1000-range goo that slows and GROUNDS. Pop Blossom carries the dash flag, so standing in the goo means the ult will not leap — the exact interaction listed in missingInteractions as dash-denied.
audit.corrected: Fling named as E with its 125 range and cooldown; Mega Adhesive named as the grounding W that denies Pop Blossom and roots anyone flung into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart opened Neeko / Skill / Singed for levels 1-3 while its own whys[0] and whys[1] describe Singed proxying and out-sustaining, and the audited mirror has Singed / Singed / Skill.
audit.why: The mirror (singed__neeko) already settled this: levels 1-2 Singed, level 3 even once Tangle-Barbs is up, overall EVEN 5.5/10.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1 and 2 set to Singed / Singed / Skill in both layers with matching ratings and whys. Overall EVEN and 5.5/10 already agree with the mirror and are left alone.

audit.why: Level 3 Tangle-Barbs, level 6 Pop Blossom (120/105/90s) and the Rylai's/Liandry's item spike are the real ones and all four spikes name them; the mirror lists the same set.

suspectNames flagged "Pop Blossom's" in wants.you[1] — that is the correct Riot name with a possessive, a false positive. Also restated from the mirror: Inherent Glamour breaks on immobilizing CC, so a Fling-into-adhesive root strips the disguise.

edits.before: Open disguised as something harmless — the first Q trade lands while Singed is still reading the wave.
edits.after: He proxies from level 1, so your E root has nothing to hit while Poison Trail farms the wave for 13 mana.

edits.before: W clone sells fake recalls and fake engages — send it at him and take the real trade from the other angle.
edits.after: Noxious Slipstream drafts him straight past you; he out-sustains poke and leaves before a level-2 Q pays.

edits.before: Full kit: E root through a minion into double-bloom Q is your core chunk. The root stretches longer through targets.
edits.after: Full kit at 3: E root through a minion into double-bloom Q — the one stage where your kit genuinely threatens his.

edits.before: E is your only CC and your only setup — whiffing it into a dash means no combo and no escape for ten seconds.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds: stood in the goo, Pop Blossom will not leap, and E is your only exit on a 10s timer.

edits.before: Singed's threat window: Rylai's + Liandry's means his poison trail slows and burns through your kite, and his W fling tosses you under tower while you're shoving.
edits.after: Singed's threat window: Rylai's plus Liandry's means Poison Trail slows and burns through your kite, and Fling (E) tosses you under tower while you are shoving.

edits.before: Singed barely lanes against you — he proxies the wave behind your tower, so the E root that's your entire win condition has nothing to hit. When he does step up to W-fling you, that's your one chance: pre-aim Tangle-Barbs at his fling range, root him, then drop a Q bloom on top. Do NOT chase him onto the green poison trail — it ticks magic damage and his passive heals it all back, so you lose every prolonged trade. Last-hit with Q from max range and respect that he's faster than you the moment he wants to be.
edits.after: Singed barely lanes against you — he proxies the wave behind your tower, so the E root that is your entire win condition has nothing to hit. When he does step up, Fling is his E and only 125 range: pre-aim Tangle-Barbs at that step, root him, then drop a Q bloom on top. Do NOT chase onto Poison Trail — it ticks the whole time he walks and his sustain wins any prolonged trade. Last-hit with Q from 800 range and respect that Noxious Slipstream makes him faster than you whenever he wants.

edits.before: Level 6 is your only real kill window: if you land E and he's not already on his poison trail, Pop Blossom's stun is the one piece of CC long enough to pin him inside your Q blooms for a full burst. Bait it after he flings — once his fling is on cooldown he can't peel your combo. But this is a knife's edge: he buys Rylai's so his trail slows you faster than you can reposition, and his sustain means a half-combo just feeds him. If your E misses, you don't get a second honest trade — you get run down. Ult only when the root is already locked.
edits.after: Level 6 is your only real kill window: land E off his step-up and Pop Blossom's stun is the one piece of CC long enough to pin him inside your Q blooms for a full burst. Check the ground first — Mega Adhesive grounds, and Pop Blossom is a leap, so goo underneath you means no ult and no exit. Go once Fling is down: it is 10s at rank 1 and 125 range, and without it he cannot peel your combo. He buys Rylai's so the trail out-slows your reposition, and a half-combo just feeds his sustain. Ult only with the root already locked.

edits.before: This is where the lane is lost on paper and you have to accept it. Singed flanks the fight, W-flings your squishy body into his team, and the move speed plus Rylai's slow means you cannot kite him off you. Your E roots him for a beat and your R stuns him for a beat — and a tanky drain-Singed simply walks through both and out-sustains your single rotation. Don't try to 1v1 him or splitpush into him. Group, ult the clustered enemies he engages onto, and make him pay for diving your carries rather than dueling the man.
edits.after: This is where the lane is lost on paper and you have to accept it. Singed flanks the fight, Flings (E) your squishy body into his team, and Noxious Slipstream plus a Rylai's slow means you cannot kite him off you. Your E roots him for a beat and your R stuns him for a beat — a tanky Singed walks through both, and Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on his trail. Don't 1v1 him or splitpush into him. Group, ult the clustered enemies he engages onto, and make him pay for diving your carries rather than dueling the man.

edits.before: Land E (Tangle-Barbs) the instant he commits a W fling, then drop Q blooms on the rooted Singed
edits.after: Land E (Tangle-Barbs) as he steps into his 125-range Fling, then drop Q blooms on the rooted Singed

edits.before: Use W clone/invisibility to dodge his fling and disengage when his poison trail is burning you down
edits.after: Send the W clone to bait Fling, and never leap Pop Blossom off Mega Adhesive — the goo grounds you

edits.before: Stack move speed and W-fling you onto his poison trail, then run you down as the slow eats your kite
edits.after: Stack move speed and Fling you into Mega Adhesive for the root, then run you down on Poison Trail

notes: The W/E swap on Singed ran through the whole matchup — every 'W fling' on the page was wrong. wants.you[2] also carried the recurring 'W clone/invisibility' error; Shapesplitter has no invisibility in the kit file.
